title: Quiz: Conditionals Deep Dive
description: Check your understanding of Conditionals Deep Dive.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in Assembly?
questions.explanation: In Assembly, ; marks a comment. Block comments use ; (line comments only).

questions.question: In boolean logic, A AND B is true when...
options: both A and B are true
either A or B is true
questions.correctAnswer: both A and B are true
questions.explanation: AND requires both sides true; OR requires only one.

questions.question: True or False: NOT flips a boolean: NOT true is false.
Fill in the blank: eligible = age >= 18 $and / && hasID
questions.explanation: AND requires both conditions to hold.

questions.question: In Assembly, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
